method: Free rule-based market intelligence from live crude-oil headlines. No paid API or AI API required.

24h.label: NEXT 24 HOURS
24h.summary: Near-term direction is driven by the balance between geopolitical supply risk, OPEC+ policy signals and fresh oil-market headlines. Expect elevated volatility when major supply developments emerge.
24h.bullish_case: Supply disruption or escalation risk can support WTI prices.
24h.bearish_case: Improving supply conditions or weaker demand expectations can pressure WTI.

7d.label: NEXT 7 DAYS
7d.summary: The weekly outlook will weigh OPEC+ decisions, inventory developments, production and refinery news, demand signals and geopolitical supply risks.
7d.bullish_case: Persistent supply disruption risk and supportive OPEC+ signals favor upside.
7d.bearish_case: Higher inventories, stronger production or weaker demand signals favor downside.

1m.label: NEXT 1 MONTH
1m.summary: The monthly view focuses on the structural supply-demand balance, OPEC+ policy, inventory trends and geopolitical developments affecting crude flows.
1m.bullish_case: Tighter supply and resilient demand can maintain an upside bias.
1m.bearish_case: Rising supply, weak demand or easing geopolitical risk can create downside pressure.
